source_claim: BellFine's official product page labels the character figure Kai Schulen, identifies its work as Valkyria Chronicles 4, describes the figure as Sega's product, and carries the SEGA copyright notice. Valkyria Chronicles 4 is an installment under SEGA's Valkyria Chronicles series.
notes: The licensee's exact character name and associated game title resolve the campaign's Kai Schulen member; no appearance outside Valkyria Chronicles is used to establish HOME.
